context:
Goal: the merge tool's permission entries describe what each tool really does.
Problem (rule): #2382 makes `merge --lane-lint` post a PR comment, but the reason text of the "Merge Tool Read Checks" allow entry in settings.json still says `--lane-lint` "changes nothing". A settings write needs your word.
Based on (measured): the auto-mode classifier refused the lane's brief for this edit (session_013NEJKz3Pbvh8FJVoT2ydk8, 22:49 CST Nov 8).
Departs from: main's reason text says "changes nothing" — it would say `--lane-lint` posts one lint comment. What the entry allows does not change.
Meanwhile: the lane finishes the rest of #2382 and does not touch the entry.

options.gain: The entry is true, so no reader trusts a wrong description.
options.how: The lane changes the one reason sentence in #2382; the allowed commands stay the same.
options.label: Yes, edit only that reason text
options.lose: One more settings commit to review.

options.label: No, leave it
options.lose: The entry stays false after #2382 merges.
